note: Daytime MBA core courses. These never count toward a concentration or certificate: every requirement document defines its coursework as electives 'beyond the required core'. They exist here so transcripts parse cleanly and so the HSM certificate's core requirement can be checked. Credits are deliberately not modelled (confirmed with Pat 2026-08-28): nothing counts them, so a wrong value could only mislead. See ADR-0029.
